citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 5 pm on Thursday,
July 10, 2026. The inspectors attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the doors to the house and barn. An
inspector called the phone number on file but the voicemail identified the line as an individual not associated with the
licensee. The inspectors waited in the driveway for approximately 30 minutes. An attempted inspection leave-behind flyer
was left. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Richard Burdeaux, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
